    graph = [[] for i in range(n)]  
    inorder = [0 for i in range(n)]
    ans = []

    for i in range(n) :
        j, k, l = nodes[i] 
        graph[k].append(j) 
        graph[l].append(j) 

    count = [1]*n
    stack = [0]
    ans.append(0)

            temp = graph[current_node].pop()

        ans.append(count[current_node])
